title: Public/Private Boundary — docs + check-private-context.sh + Security Rules
description:
EPIC-163 — 借鉴 loopx `docs/public-private-boundary.md` + `loopx check` 扫描器, 给 KALLAX 补 public/private 边界治理.

**Context**: 主公 2026-08-05 review loopx AGENTS.md 后拍板 (P1, ROI 高) — 当前 KALLAX 无 public-private boundary 检查, 没有专门的文档定义边界, 没有 scanner 工具检查 credentials / private state / local paths / raw logs. 跟 loopx 对比见 confluence/decisions/loopx-vs-kallax-governance-gap-2026-08-05.md.

**设计 (跟 loopx `loopx check` 1:1)**:
1. `docs/public-private-boundary.md` — 定义 Public (schema / CLI / adapter lifecycle / generic coordination rules) vs Private (local paths / raw logs / task IDs / credentials / person names / sub-agent prompts / trajectories)
2. `scripts/check-private-context.sh` — 扫描器, treats boundary as file-state (tracked vs untracked), 不是 path 过滤. 退出码 0=PASS / 1=FAIL / 2=BLOCKED-env
3. CLAUDE.md Section 7 — 加 Security Rules 明文规定 (不授权凭证 / 不代发布 / scan credentials before staging)
4. CONTRIBUTING.md — 加贡献前扫描 private state 要求

**0 增 Rule, 0 改 source code 之外**: 跟 EPIC-069-D check-claim-evidence 1:1 pattern, 新 immutable check script.

**跟 BE-14 关系**: 不冲突.
**跟 EPIC-054-A 关系**: 不冲突.
**跟 Rule 34 关系**: 互补 (Rule 34 = reproduction 必填, EPIC-163 = private context 必扫).
acceptance: AC1: docs/public-private-boundary.md 定义 public/private 分类清单 (跟 loopx 1:1 schema: schema / CLI / adapter lifecycle / generic coordination rules vs local paths / raw logs / task IDs / credentials / person names / sub-agent prompts / trajectories)
AC2: scripts/check-private-context.sh 扫描器 (跟 loopx `loopx check` 1:1): tracked vs untracked 双层检查
AC3: scanner 检测 4 类: credentials (api_key/token/password/secret) / private paths (/Users/.../.local/...) / raw logs (.log/.jsonl > 1MB) / sub-agent prompts (含 "system prompt" 关键词)
AC4: scanner 退出码契约: 0=PASS, 1=FAIL (fail-closed, 禁止 print FAIL + exit 0), 2=BLOCKED-env
AC5: pre-commit hook 集成 `scripts/check-private-context.sh`, staged files 必扫
AC6: CONTRIBUTING.md 加贡献前扫描 private state 要求 (引用 loopx CONTRIBUTING.md 1:1 pattern)
AC7: CLAUDE.md Section 7 加 Security Rules (不授权凭证 / 不代发布 / scan credentials before staging)
AC8: tests/integration/check-private-context.test.sh ≥8 case PASS (正常文件 / 含 credential / 含 private path / 含 raw log / 含 sub-agent prompt / 边界值 / 退出码契约 / pre-commit hook 集成)
AC9: vitest sentinel + 5-Level Verify L1-L5 PASS
AC10: 0 改 source code, 0 增 Rule (跟 EPIC-069-D 1:1 pattern)
